_comment: LoRA SV-to-MV adaptation of ss64; paired with the full fine-tune recipe derived from ss_flow_img_dit_1_3B_32_bf16_proj_multiview_ft64.json. Official SV base, frozen DINO/NAF/decoders; all self/global cross-attention and proj_linear adapters. K=1..6, fixed checkpointing, BF16 torso, FP32 adapters, no EMA; CPU accumulation packs transferred one at a time. Fresh restart after the checkpoint-free single-GPU run was stopped; retain the same data, objective, LoRA targets and EBS. Native DDP runtime; periodic checkpoint500, epoch validation.

experiment.scope: Fresh official-SV initialization; LoRA on80892 assets, five epochs. DDP retains global EBS; checkpoints500 plus epoch/final/stop.
